lines.text:
What?\c
There’s no secret hidden behind this poster or
anything like that!\c
And where’s my partner, anyway...\c
He was supposed to come trade places with me,
but he’s been ages in Lavender Town...
I’m guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!
At this rate, the location of the Team Rocket\nHideout is gonna be discovered!\c\nI better tell the boss!
